rules.notes: The guide describes an initial boss effect that changes combat-wide behaviour. Resolve the client effect/spell IDs and capture its S2C application before implementing it.
The guide describes conditional effects tied to range, movement-point removal, weapon hits and melee actions. Do not implement from prose; each trigger requires a measured rule and test.

evidence.guideSummary: The guide identifies a boss encounter with a fight-start state and action-dependent reactions. This draft records the investigation scope only; it does not define numerical combat behaviour.
